mentions.name: push10k
mentions.description: iOS app that helps track pushups toward a 10,000-pushups-in-a-year goal and stay motivated. It is free with no ads or payments.
mentions.source_excerpt: I created "push10k", an iOS app to help me keep track and stay motivated. It's free (no money, no ads) in the iOS app store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/push10k/id6754811078.
